summary: MaxsMaking Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Delisting Determination dated July 17, 2026. Nasdaq determined to delist the company's securities under discretionary Rule IM-5101-4, citing potential manipulation following an SEC trading suspension on November 17, 2025, and a subsequent Nasdaq halt on December 2, 2025. The company intends to request a hearing before an independent Hearings Panel, which will automatically stay the delisting pending a decision; trading remains halted. No financial terms, premium, or advisor are stated. What to watch: the outcome of the hearing and whether the company can demonstrate improved circumstances to reverse the delisting or faces ultimate removal from Nasdaq.
